en: The postcard features a black and white photograph of a park-like landscape with trees and paths, with a large building and a church with a pointed steeple visible in the background. The word 'Kubikenborg' is printed at the bottom left of the image. There is also cursive handwritten text along the bottom. The reverse side shows address lines, Swedish-language printed and handwritten text, a Swedish postage stamp, and a postmark.
